integrity: Universal conclusions follow from a six-step symbolic proof. The included standalone Python program gives 35 exact finite-instance tests and is not a proof of the infinite family. Independently audited status is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite nonzero associative unital rings and independent uniformly sampled factors; full profile does not recover field order and matrix dimension separately. The matrix-factor formula and enumeration of numerical values are prior work. The complete 1987 matrix-enumeration paper was not accessible for full-text priority checking.
title: The nilpotent-product profile determines the effective semisimple blocks of a finite ring
